name: context-pit-crew
description: Helps you run long Claude Code sessions with less lost to compaction: shows context, the 5-hour and weekly limits, an estimate of prompt-cache warmth and the API-equivalent cost above the prompt, has Claude check for a safe spot before the compactions it starts, and hands off to a fresh session with a short brief.

diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
diagnostics.description: Write a per-session breadcrumb file to /tmp/claude-mods-diag/ recording what the mod did and when (never text Claude wrote). For debugging only.

openPaneOnStart.title: Open the Usage pane at session start
openPaneOnStart.description: Open the Usage pane unasked when a session starts. The /pit-crew command and the meter labels open it either way.

cacheTtlMinutes.title: Prompt cache lifetime (minutes)
cacheTtlMinutes.description: How long your account's prompt cache lasts after the last request: 60 for the 1-hour cache, 5 for the 5-minute cache. Claude Code does not report it, so the Cache gauge and the going-cold warning are an estimate from this setting.

contextWatch.title: Context: watch line (%)
contextWatch.description: Context percent where the band starts advising you to watch for a good spot. Must be below the next three.

contextStatePage.title: Context: state page line (%)
contextStatePage.description: Context percent where Claude is reminded once to refresh the state page if the session keeps one. Must be above contextWatch and below contextCompact; out of order, all four use their defaults.

contextCompact.title: Context: compact line (%)
contextCompact.description: Context percent where Claude is asked once to point out the next good spot to compact, and Auto's level until you pick one from the Auto menu or with /pit-crew auto N. Must be above contextStatePage and below contextOverdue; out of order, all four use their defaults.

contextOverdue.title: Context: overdue line (%)
contextOverdue.description: Context percent where compacting is overdue and Claude is asked to suggest compacting before long work. Must be above contextCompact and at most 100; out of order, all four use their defaults.
